notes: Glean's Webflow careers page loads its own Greenhouse board client-side (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/gleanwork/jobs?content=true) and filters with the Finsweet list controls: text input #Search-Jobs[name=Search-Jobs] plus two dropdowns select#Departments[name=Departments] and select#Locations[name=Locations]. All filtering is in-page; no query parameter is sent, so the scraper loads the full board and filters locally.
